hooks.command: grep -qE 'dart format( +-[^ ";&|]+)* +\.([ ";&|)]|\n|"$)' && { echo 'Bloqueado: rode dart format so nos arquivos alterados (ex.: dart format lib test), nunca em . nem nos gerados' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

f=$(grep -o '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]*)"$/\1/; s#\\+#/#g'); case "$f" in *.g.dart|*.freezed.dart|*.mocks.dart) ;; *.dart) dart format "$f" >/dev/null ;; esac
